projecthero.saiyan.ability.combo.desc: Press R (or left click) for a five-hit combo: four quick punches and kicks for 8 damage each, then a spinning kick for 15 that knocks them back. Stop for 1.5 seconds and it starts over.
projecthero.saiyan.ability.martial.desc: A flipping kick that launches your target into the air for 12 damage, then an axe kick that slams them back down for 10. 15 Ki.
projecthero.saiyan.ability.ki_blast.desc: Hold to fire glowing Ki spheres from alternating hands, 4 a second. Each deals 5 damage with a small blast. 2 Ki per sphere.
projecthero.saiyan.ability.beam.desc: Hold to gather Ki between your cupped hands, release to fire a huge blue beam: 15 to 40 damage depending on the charge. Costs 25 to 60 Ki. Clashes with other beams.
projecthero.saiyan.ability.strong.desc: Vanish and reappear behind the enemy you are aiming at (up to 16 blocks), then hammer them into the ground with both fists for 22 damage. 25 Ki.
projecthero.saiyan.ability.spirit_bomb.d: Rise 10 blocks, charge a giant bomb above your head for up to 10 seconds, then throw it: 1000 damage and a huge crater.
projecthero.saiyan.ability.dash.desc: Burst about 10 blocks the way you are looking, leaving an afterimage. No fall damage. 5 Ki.
projecthero.saiyan.ability.rush.desc: Charge up to 14 blocks through your enemies with rapid strikes: 6 damage to each one you pass, then a blow that knocks them all flying. 15 Ki.
projecthero.saiyan.ability.aoe.desc: Release a shockwave of Ki all around you: 14 damage and a strong knockback to everyone within 7 blocks. 20 Ki.
projecthero.saiyan.ability.aoe2.desc: Leap up and rain ten Ki blasts onto the area you are aiming at (6 block radius), 4 damage each. 30 Ki.
projecthero.saiyan.ability.utility.desc: Tap or hold V to charge your Ki.
projecthero.saiyan.ability.utility2.desc: A blinding flash: every creature within 12 blocks that is facing you is blinded and slowed for 4 seconds, and mobs lose track of their target. 15 Ki.
